answer: We formulate a cryptoeconomic protocol where validator identities register within a topological state atlas, leveraging dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs to anchor each consensus state. Via a subgame-perfect slashing matrix, Sybil identity multiplication triggers quadratic capital forfeiture, guaranteeing that agents who harbor adversarial intent obtain a strictly negative expected utility E[U] < 0. Hence, honest single-identity participation converges to a strict Nash equilibrium.
